title: Let's build a Chatbot - Server settings and Feature Flags (Part 15)

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to part 15 of Let's Build a Chatbot in C-Sharp using Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到使用 C# 與 Agent Framework 打造聊天機器人的第十五部分。

cues.en: Part 15 is a little tweaks as well, like the last part was, where we introduced online
cues.zh: 第十五部分也做一些小調整，就像上一部分加入了線上，

cues.en: storage and various tweaks and refactorings.
cues.zh: 儲存，以及各種改善與重構。

cues.en: In this one, we are going to look a little about some server settings and some feature flags.
cues.zh: 這次介紹伺服器設定與功能旗標。

cues.en: Since we introduced Blob Storage and Cosmos DB, I've gotten some feedback that not everyone
cues.zh: 加入 Blob Storage 與 Cosmos DB 之後，我收到一些回饋：不是每個人，

cues.en: has the option to make a Blob Storage or a Cosmos DB by themselves, and it is annoying
cues.zh: 都能自行建立這兩項服務，現在無法使用系統，

cues.en: for them that they can't use the system now.
cues.zh: 讓他們覺得很困擾。

cues.en: So what I have done is I have made that if you just write the word local into these two
cues.zh: 所以我做了調整：只要在這兩個，

cues.en: connection strings, it will go in and check that, and then I have made that the conversation
cues.zh: 連線字串填入 local，系統就會辨識。接著把對話，

cues.en: service and the setting service that use Cosmos now is an interface, and there's two implementations
cues.zh: 服務與設定服務抽成介面，現在有兩種實作，

cues.en: of that interface, either a file conversation service and a file setting service, or the Cosmos DB versions of this.
cues.zh: 分別是檔案版的對話與設定服務，以及 Cosmos DB 版本。

cues.en: This also means that you can make a third service, use SQL Server or whatever you wish
cues.zh: 這也表示，你可以建立第三種實作，使用 SQL Server 或其他，

cues.en: to store your data in, just implementing a few methods, and then you are ready.
cues.zh: 想要的資料儲存，只需要實作幾個方法即可。

cues.en: So that has been done, and the same has been done for the Blob Storage.
cues.zh: 這部分已完成，Blob Storage 也做了相同調整。

cues.en: You can again go in and use File Storage instead, if need be, for the uploaded files and the generated images.
cues.zh: 有需要時，可以改用檔案儲存，保存上傳檔案與生成圖片。

cues.en: Similar, I've gone in and made that if you don't have a weather service key for OpenWeather,
cues.zh: 同樣地，如果沒有 OpenWeatherMap 的服務金鑰，

cues.en: you can write the word none, and if you do that, it will not expose that tool at all to the LLM.
cues.zh: 可以填入 none，這樣就完全不會把天氣工具提供給 LLM。

cues.en: So if you write none here and ask, what's the weather like in Paris, it will tell you it doesn't know, or it will come up with, based on when we are, it's roughly this and this.
cues.zh: 如果填入 none，再問巴黎天氣如何，它會說不知道，或根據目前季節推測大概情況。

cues.en: So just some quality of life for those who are not able to get those services in, else you just put in the normal connection strings and you should be up and running like normal.
cues.zh: 這些只是讓無法取得相關服務的人更方便使用。其他人照常填入連線字串，就能正常運作。

cues.en: Another thing I have done, mostly in preparation of being able to use this for some real-life
cues.zh: 另一項調整，主要是為了準備實際，

cues.en: stuff, is that I put in something called server settings.
cues.zh: 部署使用，就是加入 ServerSettings。

cues.en: So server settings is in the app settings of the app host, and they turn into this little
cues.zh: ServerSettings 放在 AppHost 的 AppSettings 中，會載入成這個，

cues.en: class where we have various use and allow options.
cues.zh: 類別，包含各種 Use 與 Allow 選項。

cues.en: The first one is allow image generation.
cues.zh: 第一個是 AllowImageGeneration。

cues.en: Image generation can be rather expensive, so you might want to expose this service, but instead of ripping it out of the code, you can just set this feature flag now in
cues.zh: 圖像生成可能很貴。如果想提供聊天服務，但不希望生成圖片，不必刪除程式碼，只要設定這個功能旗標，

cues.en: order to choose if images are allowed to be generated or not.
cues.zh: 就能決定是否允許。

cues.en: Similarly, you can choose if user memory is allowed, if custom MCP servers are allowed,
cues.zh: 同樣可以決定是否允許使用者記憶、自訂 MCP 伺服器，

cues.en: if custom instructions are allowed, and if the chat visual customization is allowed.
cues.zh: 自訂指示，以及聊天介面自訂功能。

cues.en: So all the settings here, if you turn them all on, you get the chat with all the different features, instructions, memories, and MCP servers under integration.
cues.zh: 全部開啟時，就能取得完整功能，包括指示、記憶，以及整合頁面的 MCP 伺服器。

cues.en: But if you turn them off, they will go away in the visuals and not be used, of course, in the run.
cues.zh: 如果關閉，就會從介面移除，實際執行也不會使用。

cues.en: Finally, you can also turn off file attachments and audio transcripts, so these buttons will go away if you turn these off.
cues.zh: 最後，也能關閉附件與語音轉錄，對應按鈕就會消失。

cues.en: Now you're really set with a system where you have multiple settings that you can control
cues.zh: 現在有了一套能從伺服器端控制多項設定的系統，

cues.en: on the server side, if that chatbot should be used or not, instead of ripping all the code out that you don't need.
cues.zh: 決定聊天機器人啟用哪些功能，不必把不需要的程式碼刪掉。

cues.en: Then you can turn them on when you need them, if need be.
cues.zh: 有需要時，再重新開啟即可。

cues.en: That's everything there is for this part 15.
cues.zh: 第十五部分的內容就是這些。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
